grants.description: Verify your identity using your National Insurance number and personal details
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and link your claim to your DWP records

grants.description: Share details of your disability, health condition, and care needs with DWP
grants.purpose: To assess your eligibility for Attendance Allowance and determine the appropriate rate

grants.description: Allow DWP to contact your GP or medical centre for supporting evidence if needed
grants.purpose: DWP may need to contact your GP to verify medical information or request additional evidence to support your claim

grants.description: Share details of any care home, hospital, or hospice stay
grants.purpose: To determine if you're eligible for Attendance Allowance while in institutional care and to calculate the correct payment

grants.description: Share SR1 form from medical professional stating you might have 12 months or less to live (special rules claims only)
grants.purpose: To fast-track your claim and automatically award the higher rate of Attendance Allowance under special rules for end of life

grants.description: Allow DWP to check if you're receiving other disability benefits that would affect your Attendance Allowance claim
grants.purpose: To ensure you're not already receiving a benefit that would make you ineligible for Attendance Allowance, or to adjust payment if you receive Constant Attendance Allowance

revocation.mechanism: Contact DWP Attendance Allowance helpline on 0800 731 0122 or write to Freepost DWP Attendance Allowance
revocation.effect: Application will be cancelled if consent is revoked before decision. If you're already receiving Attendance Allowance, revocation may require a change of circumstances report and could affect your payments.

delegation.agent_identity: GOV.UK AI Agent acting on behalf of citizen
delegation.limitations: Agent cannot provide medical evidence (SR1 form must come from medical professional). Agent cannot make decisions about care needs severity on citizen's behalf - citizen or their appointee must describe their own care needs. Agent cannot act as an appointee or power of attorney without proper legal authority. Agent cannot attend face-to-face medical assessments on citizen's behalf. Agent must defer to citizen for all subjective assessments of care needs and disability impact.
